entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: What is this thing!?

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: You're not soldiers of this castle, right!?[n]Get me out of here!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: Look, the key's right there!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: We're trying to get the hell out of here!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: I mean, you obviously look like an[n]enemy too!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: I'm locked up here, so how can I be your[n]enemy!? Help me out!
I don't believe you.
Quiet down.
...A cat?

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: You have to believe me!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: I'm begging you; you have to help me!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: I am NOT a cat! Say that again and I'll[n]make you regret it!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: They're catchin' up already!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Shit, there's still no service. Ain't there[n]any way to contact someone outside!?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: How the hell do we get out!?

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: Hey, you two!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: You want to know where the exit is?[n]Let me out and I'll take you there.

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: You don't want to get caught and[n]executed, right?
Can you really help us?
Sounds dangerous.
You better not be lying.

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: I never go back on my word!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: Leave it to me! I'll show you a safe[n]way out!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Even though you're behind bars?

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: This, uh... They just caught me off guard![n]That's all!

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: I'm not lying! It's the truth!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: This thing sounds like it's all talk...

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: If you guys think you can get out on[n]your own, then be my guest!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: What do we do?

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Are you seriously not messing with us!?

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: If you don't hurry, they'll catch you.

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: F-Fine...

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: Ahhhh... Freedom tastes so great...

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Now, where's the exit, you monster cat!?

entries.speaker: Strange Creature
entries.en: Don't call me a cat! I am Morgana!

entries.speaker: Sakamoto
entries.en: Shuddup and hurry it up! You wanna be[n]locked up again!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A-All right, sheesh!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Follow me, and stay quiet!
